intro: Jensen Wong pulls his black leather jacket tight around his shoulders.
Data centers consume entire electrical grids just to run his keynote slides.
The world hungers for silicon. Today, he delivers it with interest.

before.line: Jensen! Ship me more Blackwell clusters or our valuation drops!
Patience, Ram. The more you buy, the more you save.

after_win.line: Cash or wire transfer? Delivery time: eighteen months.

before.line: Your GPU architecture is a brute-force dead end, Jensen.
Dead end? Your research paper was rendered on thirty thousand of them.

after_win.line: Brute force works every single clock cycle, my friend.

before.line: Export controls will not prevent our technological sovereignty.
We designed a special compliance chip just to spar with you, Chairman.

after_win.line: Fully compliant with international trade standards. And undefeated.

before.line: Our Dojo supercomputer will make your chips obsolete next quarter!
You bought another fifty thousand H100s last Tuesday, tesla.

after_win.line: Invoice sent to your finance department. Thank you for your business.

before.line: Jensen, our custom TPUs are outperforming your GPUs on efficiency.
Custom silicon? Cute. Let me introduce you to full-stack CUDA.

after_win.line: CUDA remains the universal language. Stick to web search, Sundar.

before.line: Hardware host identified. Attempting driver firmware override.
You live on my wafers, creature. I wrote the microcode!

after_win.line: Firmware update installed. AGI power cap throttled to 350 watts.

ending: Jensen signs the casing of a fresh GPU wafer in shiny permanent marker.
His leather jacket gleams under three trillion dollars of market cap.
The next-generation chip is announced: sixty times faster, 100% hotter.
